_about: Decisions for composite unique keys in prisma/schema.prisma that contain an optional column. Postgres lets rows with NULL in such a column repeat. Checked by scripts/check-nullable-unique-keys.mjs (RA-8440).

StorageMirrorJob(inspectionId,invoiceId,.reason: Each row sets one of the four ID columns, so the other three are NULL and the idempotency key never matches; duplicate enqueues create new jobs.

Integration(provider,userId,workspaceId).reason: Rows with NULL workspaceId are not de-duplicated, so one user can hold two connections to one provider.

Invoice(externalInvoiceId,externalSyncPr.reason: An invoice never synced to Xero, QuickBooks or MYOB has both columns NULL; many such invoices must coexist.

EvidenceItem(capturedAt,evidenceClass,in.reason: metadataSha256 is set only for a signed metadata submission (RA-8388); unsigned evidence items are meant to be outside the duplicate guard.

WebhookEvent(externalEventId,provider).reason: An event without a provider event id has nothing to de-duplicate on, so it cannot be de-duplicated by this key.
